contentSection.heading: Our Product

items.description: Glass Door Cabin offers a sleek, transparent design that enhances space and modern elegance in any building.

The Glass Door Cabin is the epitome of modern elevator design, combining functionality with striking aesthetics. Crafted to offer a clear, panoramic view, this model brings openness and luxury to both commercial and residential buildings. It’s ideal for spaces where design, visibility, and user experience go hand in hand.

contentSection.heading7: Modern Design with a Panoramic Experience
contentSection.description: Engineered with toughened safety glass and framed with sleek stainless steel finishes, the Glass Door Cabin creates a spacious and sophisticated look. Whether installed in malls, apartments, corporate buildings, or luxury homes, it delivers a unique visual connection to the environment outside the elevator.

items3.text: Engineered with toughened safety glass and stainless steel framing
Creates a spacious, sophisticated panoramic look
Ideal for malls, apartments, corporate buildings, and homes
False ceiling with embedded LED lighting and blower for comfort
Automatic doors with transparent or frosted glass options

contentSection.description2: Despite its open appearance, the Glass Door Cabin is built for maximum safety and performance. Equipped with electronic door safety systems, high-resolution plasma displays inside the car, and LED digital indicators on each floor, it offers an intelligent and seamless user experience.

items4.text: Electronic door safety systems for maximum protection
High-resolution plasma displays inside the cabin
LED digital indicators on each floor
Modern SS90 square buttons and clear panels for spaciousness
Optional tinted glass, anti-smudge coatings, and designer handles
